WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
total_invoices AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Invoices
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_count,
    invoice_count / CAST((SELECT total FROM total_invoices) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share
  FROM invoice_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_average_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    s.invoice_count,
    s.share
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN average_share av
  WHERE s.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_number_of_invoices,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as average_excess
FROM above_average_shares
